title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
description:
****Who is Litmus****
Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
  
  
AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
  
  
We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
  
  
Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, robust, and modular AngularJS-based web applications.
* Translate complex product requirements into engaging and intuitive user experiences.
* Implement clean, maintainable, and scalable front-end code with a focus on high performance.
* Build reusable directives, services, and modules with an eye toward componentization and efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Backend Engineering teams to align UI functionality with underlying APIs and services.
* Contribute to UI/UX discussions, helping to shape the design and behavior of frontend components.
* Review, refactor, and optimize existing AngularJS code to improve performance and maintainability.
* Develop comprehensive tests (unit, integration, E2E) and conduct thorough code reviews and browser compatibility testing.
* Collaborate with engineers across the organization to resolve issues when necessary.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and business opportunities.
* Stay up-to-date with and incorporate industry trends and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar.
* 5+ years of professional experience building complex web applications with AngularJS in production environments.
* Strong command of TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern front-end architectures.
* Deep understanding of AngularJS internals, including scope, the digest cycle, services, and directives.
* Demonstrated ability to showcase previous UI work (e.g., portfolio, screens, live apps, dashboards, or component libraries).
* Extensive experience integrating frontend applications with backend services via RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with consuming and visualizing streaming data via APIs or websockets.
* Solid understanding of cross-browser compatibility, accessibility standards, and mobile-first design principles.
* Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and collaborative development workflows.
* Very organized, with great attention to detail
* Creative, and open to different ideas from stakeholders and other engineers
* Likes to work in a collaborative, fast-paced, and results-driven environment
* Passionate about software engineering and interested in IIoT

title: Digitalization Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**Digitalization Specialist**
to join our Third-Party Cyber Risk Management team. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in driving the software development and optimization of digitalized TPRM processes supported by web applications, ensuring they meet current and future business needs. This role involves small-scale software development, gathering business requirements, translating them into actionable technical specifications, collaborating with outsourcing developers if required, and proactively identifying opportunities for additional software development and web application improvements.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Software Development: Develop and maintain small-scale software solutions, including customizations and system administration tasks. Collaborate closely with outsourced developers, QA testers, UX specialists, and data visualization experts to deliver best-in-class web applications.
* Requirements Gathering: Work closely with stakeholders, users, and cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and document business requirements for the development of the web application.
* Technical Translation: Translate business requirements into clear, concise technical specifications to guide software development efforts.
* Collaboration with Developers: Partner with outsourcing developers to ensure the accurate and timely implementation of functionalities while maintaining quality standards.
* Quality Assurance: Oversee testing and validation processes to ensure the delivered functionalities meet requirements and function as expected.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for enhancements or new capabilities within the web application to improve user experience and meet evolving business needs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring alignment with project goals.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of requirements, use manuals, workflows, technical specifications, and implementation processes for future reference.
* Project Management: Monitor timelines and progress, ensuring projects stay on track and within scope.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (preferably in Software Engineering), Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in web software development of small-scale (e.g., Frontend - JavaScript Framework, and/ or Backend - Web Framework - Python, Relational Databases: PostgreSQL or MySQL for structured data)
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, technical documentation, QA testing, UATs, and project management.
* Familiarity with web application infrastructure, , hosting options in cloud environments and APIs, web application integrations with other systems or applications.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with external software developers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Experience with digitalization or automation projects is a plus.
* Interested in Information Security and Cybersecurity.
* Creative and entrepreneur mindset.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Knowledge of software development life cycles (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
* Knowledge of APIs and cloud infrastructure services Knowledge of Business Intelligence applications (e.g., Power BI). Ability to foresee potential system enhancements based on business trends and user feedback.

**About The Team**
This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of digital transformation, contributing to the growth and optimization of a key business tool. You’ll work with a dynamic team, collaborate with cutting-edge technology experts, and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our digitalization efforts.
  
  
If you’re passionate about bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunities to work with a global team and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Medical benefits
* Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

title: ESaaS - SFDC - Commerce Development

Strong expertise in Apex (including Batch and Queueable) and Lightning Web Components (LWC) .

  is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. **About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Principal Frontend Engineer** 
 to drive the technical vision and frontend architecture of the Cloud Secure Edge Admin Console, the interface used by IT Administrators and Security teams to manage access policies, monitor devices, configure alerts, and analyze real\-time connectivity. As a Principal Frontend Engineer, you will define long\-term frontend strategy, establish engineering standards, influence product and platform direction, mentor senior engineers, and partner across multiple teams to deliver scalable, secure, performant, and intuitive enterprise experiences.
 



 You will work with modern web technologies, including TypeScript, React, ag\-Grid, Highcharts, Storybook, and our internal component library. This role is ideal for engineers who excel at solving large\-scale architectural challenges, influencing technical direction across organizations, driving alignment in ambiguous situations, and elevating engineering excellence across teams.
 



  
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Define and drive the frontend architecture and technical roadmap for Cloud Secure Edge.
* Lead the design and delivery of complex, scalable, secure, and high\-performance frontend solutions.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for performance, accessibility, quality, maintainability, and testing excellence.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and Platform teams to influence product and technology direction.
* Drive cross\-team technical decisions and resolve complex architectural challenges.
* Mentor engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, hands\-on leadership, and engineering best practices.
* Build highly interactive, data\-intensive user experiences using React, TypeScript, React Query, Redux, ag\-Grid, Highcharts, and Storybook.
* Design and deliver complex dashboards, data visualizations, and enterprise\-grade analytics experiences.
* Champion reusable frameworks, shared components, design systems, developer productivity, and operational excellence.
* Drive improvements in testing, CI/CD, observability, and frontend development practices.
* Lead initiatives focused on frontend performance optimization, including lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, caching strategies, and rendering optimizations to improve speed, responsiveness, and scalability.



**What You'll Bring** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise web applications, including specializing in large\-scale, production\-grade ReactJS, Redux, React Query, and TypeScript applications.
* Expert\-level proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, React Query, HTML, CSS/Sass, and modern frontend architectures.
* Proven experience driving frontend architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across multiple teams.
* Proven experience designing and building highly complex UIs, data\-intensive enterprise applications, advanced dashboards, and data visualizations using technologies such as Highcharts, ag\-Grid, or similar frameworks.
* Deep expertise in frontend performance optimization, including lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, bundle optimization, rendering performance, and scalability best practices.
* Strong understanding of accessibility, security, scalability, reliability, and modern testing methodologies.
* Extensive experience developing and maintaining comprehensive unit, integration, and component test suites using frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, and related testing tools.
* Experience building and evolving design systems, component libraries, and shared frontend platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence technical decisions, and drive architectural outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated success in mentoring engineers, conducting technical reviews, and raising the engineering bar across teams.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in Cybersecurity, Networking, Zero Trust, SSE/SASE, or Cloud Security domains.
* Experience with micro\-frontend architectures, frontend platform engineering, and large\-scale distributed frontend ecosystems.
* Experience working in globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing advanced frontend observability, monitoring, and performance measurement solutions.
* Experience building highly scalable data visualization platforms, analytics products, or security\-focused dashboards handling large datasets.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

description:
Job Title
   

  

 Frontend Architect
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Frontend Architect** 
 to lead the technical strategy and design of our next\-generation web applications. In this role, you will champion the adoption of the latest
 **Angular** 
 frameworks, drive the transition to a robust
 **micro\-frontend architecture** 
 , and establish a scalable UI ecosystem using Atomic Design principles.
   

  

 While your primary domain will be the frontend, you will work closely with our backend engineering teams. Therefore, a
 **strong working knowledge of Java Spring Boot and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)** 
 is essential to ensure seamless integration and architectural alignment across the entire stack.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Leadership: Design, architect, and implement scalable frontend solutions using the latest versions of Angular (standalone components, signals, strictly typed reactive forms, etc.).
* Micro\-Frontend Strategy: Lead the migration and development of our applications into a Micro\-Frontend architecture (using Webpack Module Federation, single\-spa, or similar techniques) to enable independent deployment and scaling by autonomous teams.
* UI/UX Standardization: Establish and enforce a UI component library built strictly on Atomic Design principles (Atoms, Molecules, Organisms, Templates, Pages) to ensure high reusability, consistency, and maintainability across all digital products.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Bridge the gap between frontend and backend systems. Work closely with backend architects to design API contracts and align frontend modules with backend microservices built on Java Spring Boot.
* Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) Alignment: Translate complex business rules into technical architecture, ensuring frontend bounded contexts map logically to backend DDD structures.
* Mentorship \& Governance: Mentor senior and lead developers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and define coding standards, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines for frontend artifacts.
* Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and improve application performance, bundle sizes, rendering strategies (SSR/SSG), and core web vitals.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 14\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4\+ years in a Lead or Architectural role focusing on frontend technologies.
* Angular Expertise: Deep, hands\-on mastery of the latest Angular ecosystem, RxJS, NgRx (or similar state management), and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Pattern Proficiency: Proven experience designing and implementing Micro\-Frontend architectures at an enterprise scale.
* Component Design: Extensive experience building highly modular UI libraries utilizing the Atomic Design pattern, integrating with tools like Storybook.
* Testing \& Tooling: Strong background in frontend testing strategies (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, esbuild).


**Required Backend \& Systems Awareness**
* Java Spring Boot: Familiarity with Java and Spring Boot ecosystems. You don't need to write backend code daily, but you must be able to read it, review it, and effectively collaborate with backend developers on API design.
* Domain\-Driven Design (DDD): Strong conceptual understanding of DDD concepts (Entities, Aggregates, Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language) to align frontend architecture with the backend domain model.
* API Design: Experience consuming and helping design RESTful APIs


**Diversity \& inclusion**
 Toyota Automated Logistics is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Frontend
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 Ontic is hiring a Senior Manager, Frontend to lead frontend teams and major frontend engineering function. This leader will be accountable for delivery, technical direction, organizational effectiveness, and the growth of technical leaders.
 



 The role requires deep hands\-on knowledge of modern frontend technologies and architectures, coupled with strong people leadership. You will shape scalable frontend systems, establish engineering practices that improve quality and velocity, and ensure teams deliver secure, performant, accessible, and maintainable user experiences.
 



  





 You will partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering leadership to align frontend strategy, technical investments, and delivery plans with business priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Frontend Technical Leadership \& Architecture** 



* Define and evolve the frontend technical strategy, architecture, and engineering standards across teams.
* Guide architectural decisions involving React, TypeScript, component architecture, state management, frontend platform capabilities, design systems, API integrations, and application structure.
* Ensure frontend systems are scalable, secure, performant, accessible, maintainable, and consistent across product areas.
* Lead technical design and architecture reviews for significant frontend initiatives.
* Identify and drive solutions for systemic technical risks, architectural inconsistencies, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and developer productivity challenges.
* Evaluate emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and tools, and make pragmatic adoption decisions based on business and engineering value.



**Engineering Delivery \& Execution** 



* Lead planning and execution across multiple frontend teams, pods, or strategic initiatives.
* Establish clear delivery plans, milestones, operating rhythms, and accountability mechanisms.
* Balance delivery commitments, team capacity, technical investment, and organizational priorities.
* Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and communicate trade\-offs to stakeholders.
* Improve predictability, quality, and execution consistency through strong engineering practices, metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product and Design to translate product strategy into feasible, high\-quality technical execution plans.



**People Leadership \& Team Development** 



* Build, lead, and develop high\-performing frontend engineering teams.
* Coach emerging technical leaders to strengthen leadership capability across the organization.
* Own goal setting, performance reviews, career development, feedback, recognition, and performance management across teams.
* Drive structured hiring, onboarding, team design, capacity planning, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and growth\-oriented engineering culture.
* Create opportunities for engineers to build deep frontend expertise, technical ownership, and leadership skills.



**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Communication** 



* Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, Security, Platform, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate priorities, technical direction, delivery status, risks, and decisions clearly across teams and leadership levels.
* Facilitate effective technical and organizational discussions, resolve disagreements constructively, and drive alignment on shared outcomes.
* Connect frontend technology decisions to customer experience, business value, engineering health, and organizational goals.
* Promote a culture of transparent communication, constructive feedback, and continuous learning.



**Frontend Quality, Reliability \& Developer Experience** 



* Establish and evolve standards for accessibility, performance, reliability, testing, observability, and frontend security.
* Drive improvements in Core Web Vitals, browser compatibility, responsiveness, error monitoring, and production reliability.
* Promote scalable testing strategies across unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and visual regression testing.
* Improve frontend developer experience through shared tooling, CI/CD, documentation, reusable frameworks, and automation.
* Partner with Design and Platform teams to strengthen the design system and shared frontend capabilities.



  





**Qualifications And Experience** 



* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial frontend engineering experience and 3\+ years leading engineering teams.
* Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong experience designing and evolving frontend architectures for large\-scale, customer\-facing SaaS applications.
* Demonstrated knowledge of component systems, design systems, state management, frontend build tooling, API integration patterns, and browser performance.
* Experience leading multiple teams, a major engineering function, or a complex product area with significant frontend scope.
* Proven ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain senior technical talent.
* Strong experience with cross\-team planning, delivery management, resource planning, and stakeholder alignment.
* Experience establishing engineering standards for accessibility, testing, observability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Ability to balance hands\-on technical judgment with people leadership and business priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



**Good to Have** 



* Experience building or scaling a design system, shared component library, or frontend platform.
* Experience with micro\-frontends, modular frontend architectures, or large multi\-application frontend ecosystems.
* Experience with frontend performance monitoring, error tracking, analytics, and observability tools.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging, and progressive delivery practices.
* Experience leading frontend modernization, migration, or platform adoption initiatives.
* Familiarity with frontend security practices, including authentication, authorization, secure data handling, and browser security considerations.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality.



**What Success Looks Like** 




 30 Days
 


* Develop a clear understanding of the frontend organization, teams, technical landscape, delivery priorities, and key stakeholders.
* Build trusted partnerships across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and Security.
* Assess team health, leadership capability, talent needs, delivery risks, and frontend engineering maturity.
* Deliver an initial meaningful frontend contribution, such as resolving a priority bug, production issue, or high\-impact technical blocker.



 60 Days
 


* Establish clear team operating rhythms, delivery accountability, performance expectations, and stakeholder communication.
* Align teams on frontend technical priorities, architecture standards, and quality expectations.
* Begin coaching engineers and emerging technical leaders while addressing high\-impact delivery blockers, technical risks, and organizational gaps.
* Lead delivery of a scoped frontend feature, customer experience improvement, or engineering effectiveness initiative.



 90 Days
 


* Drive predictable execution across frontend teams and strategic initiatives.
* Strengthen frontend architecture, engineering standards, shared capabilities, and developer experience.
* Improve team effectiveness through clear goals, feedback, talent development, and leadership growth, while establishing a roadmap that balances business priorities with long\-term frontend health.
* Deliver an approved technical design and execution plan for a high\-impact frontend initiative, with clear ownership, milestones, and measurable outcomes.



  





**Ontic Benefits \& Perks** 



* Competitive Salary
* Medical Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Home Office Stipend
* Continued Education Stipend
* Festive \& Achievement Celebrations
* Dynamic Office Environment

title: Application Engineering, Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who gets energized by the moment when a piece of software you built actually clicks for the person using it. Not when it compiles without errors, but when an engineer on the other side of the world opens your application and their workflow just got easier. You have learned that the hardest part of building useful tools is not the technical implementation, it is understanding what people are actually trying to accomplish.
   

  

 You think in systems, but you communicate in plain language. When a customer describes a problem, you can hold the technical architecture in your head while also tracking what they really need versus what they think they need. You ask clarifying questions that get to the root without making people feel interrogated.
   

  

 You do not wait for perfect information before you start building. You sketch out a solution, validate the approach with the people who will use it, and iterate based on what you learn. When something does not work the way you expected, you dig into why instead of just trying a different approach and hoping it sticks.
   

  

 You care about craft. You write code that someone else can pick up six months from now and understand. You document not because someone told you to, but because you know that good documentation is a gift to your future self and everyone who comes after you.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will find a place where the applications you build get used by engineers solving real problems.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Design and build full stack web applications using Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS that integrate simulation technologies into customer engineering workflows
* Develop backend services and RESTful APIs that connect frontend interfaces to Python\-based automation engines, including PyAnsys libraries where applicable
* Work directly with customers and internal Synopsys teams to translate engineering requirements into working web solutions that fit their actual use cases
* Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, improve UI/UX prototyping, debug more effectively, and increase test coverage
* Contribute to code reviews, write clear documentation, and help maintain code quality standards across development projects
* Participate in technical demos and customer presentations to show case solutions, gather feedback, and support adoption of new capabilities


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* You will deliver web applications that make complex simulation workflows accessible and usable for engineers who depend on them to meet project deadlines
* Your backend services and APIs will enable automation that saves customers hours of manual configuration and data handling per project cycle
* The solutions you build will directly influence how customers adopt and scale simulation\-driven design processes across their engineering teams
* Your collaboration with product teams will surface real\-world usage patterns that shape roadmap priorities and improve tool usability based on actual customer needs
* Your containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines will reduce release cycles and improve reliability for customer\-facing solutions
* You will bridge the gap between advanced simulation technology and practical engineering workflows, making powerful capabilities accessible to users who are not simulation experts
* Your contributions to code quality and documentation will raise development standards for the team and accelerate onboarding for future engineers


 What You'll Need
   

  

* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 2\+ years of professional software development experience, or a Master's degree with relevant project or internship experience
* You bring strong proficiency in Python for backend development, including hands\-on experience with Python\-based web or UI frameworks
* You have working knowledge of frontend development concepts and UI/UX principles, with the ability to translate user needs into functional interfaces that people actually want to use
* You are comfortable using Git for version control in a collaborative team environment where multiple people are working in the same codebase
* You have a solid understanding of core backend and infrastructure concepts, including RESTful API design, network fundamentals, and database systems, enabling you to effectively contribute to robust, full\-stack application development.
* You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and can explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without losing the important details
* Experience with the Ansys software ecosystem ,PyAnsys, or similar scientific and engineering application domains is a plus, as is familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can sit with a customer or internal stakeholder, listen to what they are trying to accomplish, and walk away with enough clarity to start building without needing every detail spelled out in advance
* When you review code or see a UI that does not quite work, you speak up with specific suggestions instead of just noting that something feels off, and you do it in a way that helps the team move forward
* You manage multiple threads at once without dropping details, a bug fix, a new feature request, and a deployment can all be in flight and you know exactly where each one stands
* You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adjusting your communication style so that nothing gets lost in translation and everyone stays aligned
* You test your own work thoroughly before handing it off because you know that catching issues early saves everyone time downstream and builds trust with the people depending on your code
* You are genuinely curious about how simulation and engineering tools get used in the real world, and that curiosity makes you ask better questions and build better solutions


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Ansys Customer Excellence team, working at the intersection of engineering simulation, modern software platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions. This is a technical role where you will collaborate with customers, internal product teams, and engineers across geographies to shape how simulation technologies are integrated into scalable, cloud\-native platforms. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current initiatives, and collaboration model during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
**Job: Technical Lead (AI\-First \| Strong Fundamentals \| MVP Builder)**




  





 At
 **Infotech.Works** 
 , we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
 **2–6 months** 
 , starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.
 



 We’re looking for a
 **Technical Lead** 
 who combines
 **deep engineering fundamentals** 
 with
 **AI\-powered speed** 
 —someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade\-offs, and still ship fast.
 



 This role is for someone who can
 **think deeply and execute quickly** 
 .
 



  





**What You’ll Do**



* Translate business ideas into
 **robust technical architectures and system designs**
* Lead
 **discovery sessions** 
 and create structured solution blueprints
* Design and build
 **MVPs that are fast to launch but don’t collapse at scale**
* Make key decisions on:
* Data models
* System boundaries
* API contracts
* Performance trade\-offs
* Guide developers through
 **clean implementation, code quality, and design thinking**
* Introduce reusable patterns and
 **standardized architecture approaches**
* Use AI tools to accelerate development—
 **without compromising engineering quality**



  





**Core Requirement: Strong Engineering Fundamentals (Critical)**




 We are
 **not** 
 looking for surface\-level developers who rely only on AI.
 



 You must be strong in:
 



  





**Database Design** 



* Schema design (normalized vs denormalized)
* Indexing strategies and query optimization
* Handling large datasets and performance bottlenecks
* Designing for reporting, analytics, and scalability
* Writing efficient SQL and understanding execution plans



  





**System Design \& Architecture** 



* Designing scalable, modular, and maintainable systems
* Clear understanding of:
* Monolith vs microservices (and when NOT to over\-engineer)
* API design and contract\-first thinking
* Caching strategies, queues, background jobs
* Ability to design systems that evolve from
 **MVP → scale without rework**



  





**Problem Solving** 



* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured solutions
* Strong debugging and performance optimization skills



  





**AI\-First Mindset (Equally Important)** 




 You should actively use AI to
 **move faster** 
 , not to replace thinking.
 


* Daily use of tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor
* Ability to
 **learn new stacks quickly using AI\-assisted workflows**
* Comfortable integrating APIs like OpenAI API into products
* Use AI for:
* Rapid prototyping
* Debugging
* Code generation
* Architecture exploration



 The key difference:
 



 You
 **verify, refine, and improve AI output using strong fundamentals** 




  





**Experience Required**



* 7–10 years of software development experience
* Proven track record of
 **shipping multiple MVPs or products end\-to\-end**
* Experience in
 **startup, product studio, or consulting environments preferred**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead small teams



  





**Technology Expectations**




**Backend** 



* Laravel (PHP), Node.js (Express/Nest), or Python (Django/FastAPI)
* Strong API design and integration experience



**Frontend** 



* React / Next.js / Vue
* Ability to quickly build functional, usable interfaces



**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, SES, CloudWatch)
* Docker, CI/CD, Git



**Databases** 



* Strong expertise in MySQL / PostgreSQL (must\-have)
* Exposure to NoSQL is a plus



  





**Who You Are**



* You understand
 **why things work** 
 , not just how to use them
* You can
 **design systems from scratch** 
 , not just assemble components
* You are comfortable with ambiguity but
 **bring structure quickly**
* You move fast—but
 **never compromise on core design quality**
* You use AI as a
 **multiplier** 
 , not a crutch



  





**Ideal Candidate Mindset**




 “I can design the system, optimize the database, and ship the product. AI helps me go faster—but I know what good engineering looks like.”

 the engineering bar

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET, Microsoft Azure, and Angular to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications.  Ensure adherence to Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout project execution.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 Backend\-
   

  

 Strong experience in C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core/.NET 6/7/8
   

  

 Experience in developing REST APIs and Microservices
   

  

 Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
   

  

 Knowledge of Entity Framework and LINQ
   

  

 Frontend\-
   

  

 Strong expertise in Angular 10\+
   

  

 TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap
   

  

 Experience with state management and component\-based architecture
   

  

 Understanding of responsive and cross\-browser development
   

  

 Cloud \& DevOps\-
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure
   

  

 Azure App Services
   

  

 Azure Functions
   

  

 Azure Storage Accounts
   

  

 Azure Service Bus
   

  

 Azure SQL Database
   

  

 Azure Key Vault
   

  

 Azure Monitor/Application Insights
   

  

 Azure DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines
   

  

**Required Qualifications\-**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
   

  

 5\-8 years of software development experience.
   

  

 Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Angular.
   

  

 Strong experience building enterprise applications on Microsoft technology stack.
   

  

 Experience working in Agile development environments.
   

  

 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications\-**
 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-204, AZ\-305, AZ\-900\)
   

  

 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
   

  

 Experience with Event\-Driven Architecture
   

  

 Knowledge of Design Patterns and SOLID Principles
   

  

 Exposure to AI/ML integration and Azure OpenAI services
   

  

 Experience with BDD/TDD practices
   

  

 Key Competencies\-
   

  

 Strong technical leadership
   

  

 Ownership and accountability
   

  

 Problem\-solving mindset
   

  

 Team collaboration
   

  

 Customer\-focused approach
   

  

 Continuous learning attitude

description:
**Hiring for a Client \- Aretto** 




  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Own the Shopify theme end to end including Liquid, JSON templates, sections, blocks and metaobjects
* Optimize Core Web Vitals on mobile and ensure high conversion performance
* Build and ship conversion\-critical experiences including size\-selector, expandable\-sole explainer and size\-chart
* Build and instrument A/B tests on PDP, collection and cart pages
* Implement analytics and event tracking including GA4, Meta CAPI, server\-side tagging and consent handling
* Evaluate, integrate and replace Shopify apps with native code where needed
* Integrate with WMS/3PL, ERP, returns, reviews, WhatsApp/SMS and marketing automation via Shopify APIs and webhooks
* Implement JSON\-LD, clean heading structure, canonical and hreflang handling for SEO
* Build collection and blog templates for content publishing
* Own version control, staging themes, code review and peak\-season readiness



**Requirements** 




 1Strong Shopify Developer Profile with hands\-on theme development and D2C e\-commerce background
 



 2Mandatory (Experience 1\): Must have 3\+ years of hands\-on Shopify development, including at least one Online Store 2\.0 theme they built or substantially rebuilt end\-to\-end.
 



 3Mandatory (Experience 2\): Must have hands\-on experience in PDP development and website design on Shopify
 



 4Mandatory (Experience 3\): Must have demonstrable performance\-optimization experience on Shopify storefronts, including improving mobile Core Web Vitals (LCP / CLS).
 



 5Mandatory (Experience 4\): Must have experience building and instrumenting A/B tests on PDP / collection / cart, working with marketing on hypotheses rather than only implementation.
 



 6Mandatory (Tech skill 1\): Must have strong hands\-on Liquid / HTML / modern CSS / vanilla JavaScript, with the ability to read and debug a theme they didn't build.
 



 7Mandatory (Tech skill 2\): Must have hands\-on experience with Shopify Admin API / Storefront API / webhooks, and at least one custom app or Shopify Function.
 



 8Mandatory (Tech skill 3\): Must have a Git\-based workflow, Shopify CLI experience, and a track record of deploying without breaking a live store (staging themes / code review / rollback).
 



 9Mandatory (Tech skill 4\): Must have experience implementing analytics and event tracking correctly — GA4 / Meta CAPI / server\-side tagging / consent handling.
 



 10Mandatory (Skill): Must be comfortable working with analytics and making decisions based on data
 



 11Mandatory (Company): Must come from a D2C e\-commerce company running its website on Shopify.
 



 12Mandatory (Working style): Must be comfortable working from an outcome and constraints instead of a fully specified ticket, and improving a live store already taking orders, not only greenfield builds.
 



 13Mandatory (Exclusion): Not suitable for candidates who only configure apps and page builders. This role requires someone who writes code.
 



 14Mandatory (Note): Will be responsible for building and owning both the current domestic storefront and the upcoming international storefront.
 



 15Preferred (Domain): D2C fashion / footwear / apparel / kids' category experience.
 



 16Preferred (Tech): Headless / Hydrogen experience; Shopify Plus / Shopify Markets / checkout extensibility; JSON\-LD and technical SEO / AEO for e\-commerce; and the ability to implement a Figma file faithfully while flagging what won't work on mobile.

description:
**About Toll Group**
 At Toll, we do more than just logistics \- we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Execute tasks leveraging domain expertise in ServiceNow development, with a focus on ITSM and ITOM modules.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of organizational processes and platform capabilities.
* Analyze and resolve a range of moderately complex issues using established policies, ITIL best practices, and platform governance standards.
* Operate with moderate supervision, following structured procedures and development guidelines.
* Perform a variety of routine and semi\-complex assignments across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, SAM, HAM, HRSD, GBS and Employee Center.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of new team members.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**What You’ll Need**
* 7\-12 years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development and platform configuration.
* Proven experience in implementing and supporting ServiceNow ITSM and ITOM modules, including Discovery, CMDB, Event Management, and Service Mapping.
* Proficiency in designing and maintaining integrations using REST, SOAP, and other web technologies (HTTP, AJAX, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C\+\+).
* Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Node.js, jQuery, Apache Jelly, or React.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Experience in developing and deploying ServiceNow applications and modules including Employee Center, SAM, HAM, HRSD, and ITSM.
* Create and implement Business rules, UI Actions, UI Policies, and Client Scripts for various applications in ServiceNow.
* Develop strategies for identifying issues and gaps for various modules in ITSM and ITOM areas.
* Experienced in various phases of Event Management which includes configuring Event Mapping Rules, Event Transform Rules, and Alert Rules.
* Experienced in customizing Email Notifications, Inbound Email Actions, Reports, and Dashboards.
* Implemented integrations between ServiceNow and third\-party applications using REST and SOAP APIs. Experienced in creating homepages and dashboards for stakeholders.
* Ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code; debug and optimize for performance and scalability.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. title: Tech Lead – Production Support & Application Development
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 Technical Lead – Production Support \& Application Development
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on technical professional with 5\+ years of experience in production support and application development for enterprise applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, contribute to application enhancements, and work closely with development, QA, support, product, and business teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud platforms.
* Perform root cause analysis and contribute to permanent fixes to reduce recurring incidents.
* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain enterprise application features, services, and integrations.
* Analyze logs, monitoring alerts, database issues, and system behavior to identify and resolve defects.
* Support deployment, release validation, post\-release checks, and operational stability activities.
* Collaborate with development, QA, support, product, and business teams to ensure timely issue resolution and smooth delivery.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, production support, application support, or production engineering.
* Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and backend application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, query troubleshooting, and data validation.
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
* Experience troubleshooting application, API, database, integration, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, Agile/DevOps practices, and release support.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and basic understanding of containers or cloud\-hosted applications.


 Good\-to\-have Skills
   

  

* Experience with Salesforce integrations, CRM platforms, licensing, entitlement, order management, subscription, or customer\-facing business applications.
* Knowledge of GraphQL, microservices, messaging platforms, API management, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Application Insights, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar platforms.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should be a practical, hands\-on engineer with strong debugging skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to balance production stability with development delivery. They should communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and be willing to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.
   

  

 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

This role requires a combination of technical expertise, team management, and the ability to foster a collaborative, results\-driven team culture. The ideal candidate should be a strong communicator with a passion for problem\-solving, mentoring, adoptable and driving continuous improvement within the new engineering process. You have to oversee the development of application code, contribute to and manage version\-controlled source code repositories, and manage assigned tasks to create measurable value and deliver software to market using industry\-recognized best practices. The lead should advocate the standards and guidelines set by the architects and leadership teams and must demonstrate quality, brevity, and timeliness in all deliverables. Technical lead have to raise the team's adoption of AI\-driven engineering practices, and use AI strategically for delivery planning, risk assessment, and productivity gains. You will contribute technically towards the delivery, health, and growth of the entire team.

**In This Role, The Candidate Will**
* Manage a scrum team to deliver project deliverables on time and be the main technical face of the team for any decision.
* Successfully run Agile ceremonies and work closely with Product Owners on keeping the roadmap and the team’s current capacity in balance.
* Help to educate and mentor other engineers, and participate in on\-call duties for production issues as required.
* Develop application code according to requirements and assigned tasks.
* Contribute to lifecycle Flow and value streams by following and prescribing methodologies and best practices.
* Solve the most difficult software development challenges.
* Maintain a balance of business and technical acumen in decision making.
* Contribute to source\-code management and work item tracking best practices.
* Contribute to the estimation process during planning exercises.
* Provide consultation to the development management team.
* Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design reviews, writing user stories, reviewing code submitted by other engineers, and automated testing.


**Experience**
**We Are Looking for Someone Who Brings**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 4 years building and supporting .NET Framework/.NET ecosystem\-based applications.
* Has 2\-4 years of experience in managing a scrum team
* Has 2\-4 years of experience developing with the Power Platform / Dynamics 365 / Dataverse


**Must\-have Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) design and principles and is comfortable with working within an established code base.

* Experience developing RESTful and SOAP APIs.
* Experience with developing middleware and interacting with components such as Azure Service Bus, Azure Function, and Kafka.
* Expertise working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript / jQuery.
* Experience working in one or more RDBMS such as SQL server and PostgreSQL.
* Agile development experience using a scrum tool such as Jira.
* Experience with Git and version control software such as GitHub or Bitbucket.

* Authentication and authorization using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2\.0, and/or SAML.

* Experience with cross\-repository dependency stewardship.
* Experience developing microservices and event\-driven processing.

* Experience with performance testing and APMs at the enterprise level.

* Experience with Association Management software or the Association space.

title: App Developer – React Native / React.js
description:
**Role Overview** 




 Durolt Technologies Pvt. Ltd., the technology arm of the Fonzel group, builds and operates a cloud\-based smart locker platform used across Indian Railways, hospitality, financial institutions, and corporate/institutional clients. We are looking for a Junior App Developer to join our Pune\-based product engineering team and work on the mobile, tablet, and Progressive Web App (PWA) applications that power the Durolt locker ecosystem.
 



 This role is suited to a developer with 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in React Native and/or React.js who is looking to grow under the guidance of senior developers, contribute to live product features, and build a strong foundation in mobile\-first, cloud\-first application development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •     Develop and maintain mobile and tablet applications using the React Native framework for Android and iOS, under the guidance of senior developers.
 



 •     Build and maintain Progressive Web App (PWA) modules using React.js.
 



 •     Integrate REST APIs to connect app screens with the Durolt backend and tenant portal services.
 



 •     Assist in integrating third\-party services such as Email, SMS, Payment Gateway, and FCM for push notifications.
 



 •     Support testing and debugging, and resolve bugs identified by QA or reported in production.
 



 •     Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies – sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and sprint reviews.
 



 •     Collaborate closely with QA engineers, backend developers, and the Product team to ship features on schedule.
 



 •     Assist with app builds, releases, and version upgrades on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
 



 •     Write clean, well\-documented code following team coding standards, and use Git for version control.
 



 •     Stay current with React Native/React.js updates and proactively suggest improvements to app performance and user experience.
 



**Requirements \& Qualifications** 




 •     1–3 years of experience in React Native and/or React.js development (strong internship or project experience considered for candidates at the lower end of this range).
 



 •     Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and core React concepts – components, hooks, and state management.
 



 •     Basic understanding of REST API integration and asynchronous data handling.
 



 •     Exposure to native Android (Java/Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) is an added advantage, not mandatory.
 



 •     Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
 



 •     Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
 



 •     Willingness to learn cloud services (AWS Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS) and IoT\-related integrations relevant to smart locker devices.
 



 •     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on project experience).
 



**Domain Exposure – Smart Locker / IoT Stack (Good to Have)** 




 Durolt's app runs on kiosk tablets embedded in physical locker hardware, so the platform goes deeper than a typical mobile app — offline\-first data, MQTT\-based device communication, and direct hardware integration. As a Junior App Developer you are not expected to have production experience across all of the areas below; you'll work under a senior developer's guidance to build this depth over time. Prior exposure, coursework, or personal\-project familiarity with any of these is a strong plus and will fast\-track your growth into a mid\-level role.
 



**1\. Offline\-first \& local database** 




 •     SQLite hands\-on: react\-native\-sqlite\-storage, op\-sqlite, WatermelonDB or Realm
 



 •     Schema migrations without data loss on already\-deployed devices
 



 •     Sync engine: outbox/queue pattern, retries with backoff, idempotency keys
 



 •     Conflict resolution, clock skew, soft deletes/tombstones
 



 •     Encryption at rest (SQLCipher / encrypted Realm)
 



 •     Data retention and purge so the DB doesn't grow unbounded on kiosk devices
 



**2\. MQTT \& realtime** 




 •     MQTT 3\.1\.1/5, QoS levels, and when each matters for a lock command
 



 •     Topic design, retained messages, Last Will \& Testament for offline detection
 



 •     Persistent sessions, reconnect with backoff, keepalive tuning
 



 •     TLS, per\-device credentials, broker ACLs
 



 •     MQTT over WebSocket; comparison with WebSocket/SSE/polling
 



 •     Command acknowledgement and de\-duplication (a locker must not open twice)
 



 •     Brokers: Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, AWS IoT Core
 



**3\. Works\-without\-cloud behaviour** 




 •     Local\-only unlock flow, cached permissions, queued audit logs when the cloud is unreachable
 



 •     Device\-to\-controller comms on LAN (local REST, TCP, on\-prem MQTT broker)
 



 •     Feature flags / remote config to change behaviour without a store release
 



**4\. Hardware \& peripheral integration** 




 •     BLE (react\-native\-ble\-plx), NFC/RFID readers, QR/barcode scanning
 



 •     Camera pipeline for face capture, on\-device liveness/quality checks
 



 •     Thermal/label printers, USB serial or OTG for relay boards and locker controllers
 



 •     Background tasks, foreground services, wake locks, boot\-time auto\-start
 



 •     Kiosk mode / device\-owner / lock task mode, MDM (Scalefusion, Knox, Android Enterprise)
 



**5\. Native layer depth** 




 •     Gradle, ProGuard/R8, ABI splits, signing; Xcode, CocoaPods, provisioning, entitlements
 



 •     Writing native modules and bridging vendor SDKs; JSI / Turbo Modules, New Architecture
 



 •     Debugging native crashes, not just JS errors
 



**6\. Security** 




 •     Android Keystore / iOS Keychain, no secrets in the bundle
 



 •     Certificate pinning, short\-lived tokens for kiosk devices
 



 •     Root/jailbreak and tamper detection, screen recording protection
 



 •     Biometric/PII handling and consent (relevant given face auth)
 



**7\. APM \& observability** 




 •     Sentry / Crashlytics / Bugsnag with source map upload in CI
 



 •     Crash\-free session rate, ANR tracking, release health per version
 



 •     Offline log buffering with later upload, remote log pull from field devices
 



 •     Custom events: unlock attempt, unlock success, sync failure, hardware timeout
 



 •     Error boundaries and graceful degradation when network or hardware is unavailable
 



**8\. Release engineering** 




 •     OTA updates (CodePush / EAS Update) and knowing what cannot ship OTA
 



 •     Fastlane or EAS pipelines, staged rollouts, forced\-upgrade handling for fleets
 



 •     Old app versions still talking to the current API
 



**9\. Testing depth** 




 •     Jest \+ React Native Testing Library; Detox or Maestro for E2E
 



 •     Testing offline paths and hardware failures with mocks
 



 •     Physical low\-end Android device testing, not just simulators
 



**10\. Kiosk UX** 




 •     Accessibility, large\-touch layouts, multi\-language
 



 •     Clear offline/error states for a user standing at a locker
 



**11\. Performance** 




 •     Hermes, bundle size, startup time (matters on cheap kiosk tablets)
 



**What We Offer** 




 •     The opportunity to work on Durolt's smart locker and IoT platform, deployed with enterprise clients such as Railways, Nayara Energy, Nokia, Bharat Electronics Limited, and the Aditya Birla Group.
 



 •     Hands\-on mentorship from senior developers and exposure to the complete mobile app development lifecycle.
 



 •     A collaborative, fast\-paced product engineering environment.
 



 •     Competitive compensation package.
 



 •     Learning and growth opportunities across mobile, cloud, and IoT technologies.
 



**How to Apply** 




 Please send your updated resume, along with a portfolio or GitHub link, to contact@fonzel.com with the subject line “Application – App Developer (React Native/React.js)”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 7 working days.

* Lead AEM UI Development – Design and develop complex, scalable, reusable AEM components using HTL/Sightly, Editable Templates, Clientlibs, and modern front\-end technologies.

* Modern Front\-End \& React Integration – Drive ReactJS integration with AEM, component\-driven architecture, headless approaches, and migration from legacy jQuery/UI implementations.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we shape it. Embark on a transformative journey as Lead Engineer , where you'll spearhead the delivery of the technology stack, using strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions coming up with the process design of the Foundational / Consolidated and Business data Products. You will be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts, and business stakeholders.
   

  

**To be successful as a Lead Engineer, you should have experience with:**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Java JDK 17\+ \& REST (Open Api).
* Proficiency in Angular, React JS, Java scripting and HTML \& J Unit 5, Integration testing and Acceptance Testing and associated libraries.
* Strong exposure of TDD software development practices.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, especially AWS or OpenShift.
* Practical knowledge and hands‑on experience with AI\-powered development tools such as Copilot, Claude Code, and GitLab Duo.
* Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript skills with proficiency in React \& experience using Gradle, ideally with Kotlin DSL.
* Proficiency with Docker \& CI/CD automation experience (Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus Repository) \& understanding of container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Experience with data messaging platforms like Apache Kafka.
* Familiarity with data analytics platforms and tools such as Spark and Elasticsearch \& Scrum Master experience.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* A self\-starter with good communication \& and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring or leading small development teams.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune, IN.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
The Frontend Developer will translate product requirements and design mock‑ups into high‑quality, responsive web interfaces that deliver a seamless user experience. Working closely with product managers, UX designers, and backend engineers, the role owns the end‑to‑end implementation of UI components, ensures cross‑browser compatibility, and contributes to the front‑end codebase’s maintainability. The developer will also troubleshoot visual bugs, optimize page performance, and help evolve the component library to meet evolving business needs. This position requires independent execution of features while collaborating regularly with cross‑functional stakeholders to align technical decisions with user and business goals.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and ship reusable UI components using React and TypeScript based on design specifications.
* Implement responsive layouts with CSS Grid and Flexbox to support mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and handle client‑side data flow, ensuring proper error handling and loading states.
* Write unit and integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library to maintain code reliability.
* Optimize page load times and runtime performance through code splitting, lazy loading, and asset minimization.
* Conduct cross‑browser testing and accessibility audits to meet WCAG standards.
* Maintain and evolve the shared component library, documenting usage guidelines for other developers.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards.
* Collaborate with the DevOps team to improve the front‑end build pipeline and CI processes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 4 years of professional experience building production‑grade web applications.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complete frontend features from concept to deployment.
* Strong understanding of web standards, accessibility best practices, and responsive design.
* Effective communication skills for interacting with product, design, and engineering teams.


**Required Skills**
* Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and modern language features.
* Hands‑on experience with React (or a comparable component framework) and component‑based architecture.
* Expertise in HTML5 and CSS3, including Flexbox, Grid, and preprocessors such as Sass.
* Working knowledge of TypeScript for type‑safe development.
* Ability to write unit and integration tests using Jest or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Git version control and branching workflows.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and cross‑browser compatibility.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with state‑management libraries such as Redux or MobX.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for automated testing and deployment.
* Professional certification related to front‑end development or UI engineering.
* Track record of working in Agile Scrum teams delivering iterative releases.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of performance profiling tools like Lighthouse and Chrome DevTools.
* Familiarity with CSS‑in‑JS solutions (e.g., styled‑components, Emotion).
* Understanding of Progressive Web App (PWA) concepts and service worker implementation.
